ValidationRule.description: A bookmark is a decision record: after creation only Status may change. Add later comments as Notes.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT(ISNEW()) && OR( ISCHANGED(Candidate__c), ISCHANGED(Job_Role__c), ISCHANGED(Candidate_Evaluation__c), ISCHANGED(Overview_Snapshot__c), ISCHANGED(Score__c), ISCHANGED(Band__c), ISCHANGED(Reasoning__c), ISCHANGED(Notes__c), ISCHANGED(Bookmarked_At__c), ISCHANGED(Bookmark_Key__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Bookmarks are immutable decision records. Only Status can change; add later comments as Notes.
